description: Search Tallahassee-Leon County GIS open geospatial datasets (parcels, zoning, public works & planning) by keyword. Returns each dataset's name, summary, record_count, owner/org, and its Feature Service `url`, pass that url to query_layer / layer_info. For a record count (optionally by a field such as city) use arcgis_tallahassee_count_records, which finds the layer by name.

org_id.description: Optional ArcGIS orgId to override the default (Tallahassee-Leon County GIS).

name: arcgis_tallahassee_search_datasets
title: Arcgis Tallahassee Search Datasets
